# Distill

Distill compacts local Markdown into agent context using templates and CLI/API agents.

- Documentation: https://github.com/smeltery/distill/tree/master/docs
- Quick start: https://github.com/smeltery/distill/blob/master/docs/quick-start.md
- Commands and limitations: https://github.com/smeltery/distill/blob/master/docs/commands.md
- License: https://github.com/smeltery/distill/blob/master/LICENSE

Markdown ingestion is implemented. PDF, EPUB, Notion, URL, and GitHub ingestion,
validate, publish, automatic index generation, and incremental skipping are not.
